completion_promises.criterion_text: Loading a four-folder corpus produces CorpusChunks with correct source_type per folder (covers @key-example @ingestion scenario "loader infers source type")
completion_promises.evidence: load_corpus walks the four canonical folders and assigns SourceType per parent directory via SOURCE_TYPE_FOLDERS mapping. Verified by unit test test_loader_infers_source_type_from_each_of_four_folders AND by the pytest-bdd scenario 'The corpus loader infers a chunk's source type from the folder it lives in' (now binding successfully via the new step definitions in features/primary-text-rag-and-quote-verifier/test_primary_text_rag_and_quote_verifier.py).

completion_promises.criterion_text: AQA past-paper-named file is refused; refusal log line references publisher prohibition (covers @negative @ingestion @copyright scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: AQA_REFUSAL_PATTERN regex applied to filename in _process_file before any read. Refusal recorded with reason=AQA_ASSESSMENT_MATERIAL and detail mentioning 'publisher prohibition'. Verified by unit tests test_aqa_named_file_is_refused_with_publisher_log + parametrised test_aqa_pattern_catches_assessment_material_filenames AND by BDD scenario 'A file matching an AQA assessment-material pattern is refused at ingestion'.

completion_promises.criterion_text: In-copyright modern set text in primary_text/ is refused; log advises per-student Phase 2 path (covers @negative @ingestion @copyright scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: INCOPYRIGHT_TITLES frozenset matched case-insensitively against normalised filename stem. Refusal detail references 'per-student Phase 2 path'. Verified by unit tests + BDD scenario 'An in-copyright modern set text placed under primary text is refused at ingestion' which asserts both the refusal record naming the file AND that the detail advises the per-student Phase 2 path.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Empty primary_text/ folder produces zero chunks and no error (covers @boundary @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: load_corpus on an empty corpus skeleton returns IngestResult with chunks_created=0 and chunks=[], no exception raised. Verified by unit test test_empty_primary_text_folder_produces_zero_chunks_no_error AND by BDD scenario 'An empty primary-text folder produces no chunks and no error' which asserts no chunks emitted from the folder AND a successful ingestion summary returned.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Whitespace-only file is skipped with structured log (covers @boundary @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _process_file checks `not text.strip()` and emits SkipRecord(reason=WHITESPACE_ONLY) plus a logger.warning. Verified by unit test test_whitespace_only_file_is_skipped AND by BDD scenario 'A whitespace-only source file produces no chunks' which asserts the skip record names the file.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Corrupted file in primary_text/ is skipped; valid file in same folder still loads (covers @edge-case @ingestion @resilience scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: read_text wrapped in try/except for UnicodeDecodeError and OSError; on failure SkipRecord(CORRUPTED_FILE) is appended and processing continues. Verified by unit test test_corrupted_file_is_skipped_and_valid_neighbour_still_loads AND by BDD scenario 'A corrupted source file does not prevent the rest of the corpus from loading' which asserts valid chunks emitted, corrupted skip recorded, and skipped file named in the summary.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Path-traversal file is rejected; refusal log names the attempt (covers @edge-case @ingestion @security scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _process_file calls Path.resolve(strict=True) then relative_to(root); ValueError → RefusalRecord(PATH_TRAVERSAL) whose path field names the offending file. Verified by unit test test_symlink_escaping_corpus_root_is_refused AND by BDD scenario 'A source file whose path traverses outside the corpus root is rejected at ingestion' (uses an os.symlink in primary_text/ pointing outside the corpus root, asserts refusal+naming+no-chunks).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Plays produce chunks with PlayCitationAnchor (act/scene/line); novels produce chunks with NovelCitationAnchor (chapter/paragraph) (covers @edge-case @verify @integration @citation scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _infer_citation_anchor dispatches on ACT vs CHAPTER markers and runs _infer_play_anchor / _infer_novel_anchor state-machine walkers that capture the first content line/paragraph at-or-past the chunk's char_offset. Verified by unit tests test_play_chunks_carry_play_citation_anchor (Macbeth → PlayCitationAnchor act=1/scene=1) and test_novel_chunks_carry_novel_citation_anchor (Christmas Carol → NovelCitationAnchor chapter=1) plus the seam test test_corpus_chunk_carries_typed_citation_anchor.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No chunk carries an unset/default source-type label (covers @key-example @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: source_type on CorpusChunk is non-defaulted and is only ever set from SOURCE_TYPE_FOLDERS lookup. Verified by unit test test_no_chunk_carries_default_or_unset_source_type AND by the BDD scenario's third Then-step '_then_no_chunk_has_default_source_type' which asserts every chunk's source_type is a SourceType enum member with a value in the canonical set.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Files use `from __future__ import annotations`, modern PEP 604 union syntax, type hints on all public functions, docstrings on public symbols, specific exception catches (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError, NotImplementedError), pathlib.Path throughout, logging module (no print). Pytest collection across both unit and BDD suites passes cleanly with zero compile errors and zero test failures (20/20 unit + 7/7 BDD for TASK-PRV-002 + 5/5 unaffected TASK-PRV-003 BDD).
